papers.title: Stratifying Reinforcement Learning with Signal Temporal Logic
papers.abstract: In this paper, we develop a stratification-based semantics for Signal Temporal Logic (STL) in which each atomic predicate is interpreted as a membership test in a stratified space. This perspective reveals a novel correspondence principle between stratification theory and STL, showing that most STL formulas can be viewed as inducing a stratification of space-time. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：本文提出了一种基于分层语义的信号时序逻辑（STL）解释方法。

简述：研究中，作者将每个原子谓词视为在分层空间中的成员资格测试，从而揭示了分层理论与STL之间的新对应关系。这一视角不仅为分析STL公式的结构提供了新的理论框架，还展示了大多数STL公式如何诱导时空的分层。

papers.title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract: What does it take to build a visual reasoner that works across charts, science, spatial understanding, and open-ended tasks? The strongest vision-language models (VLMs) show such broad visual reasoning is within reach, but the recipe behind them remains unclear, locked behind proprietary reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines with non-public data. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：Vero是一个开放的视觉推理强化学习框架，适用于多种视觉任务。

简述：Vero通过开放的强化学习方法，构建了一系列视觉语言模型，能够在图表、科学和空间理解等多种视觉推理任务中表现优异。该框架的核心贡献在于提供了透明的训练流程和数据集，使得研究人员能够更好地理解和复现视觉推理模型的性能。

papers.title: Analyzing Symbolic Properties for DRL Agents in Systems and Networking
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has shown remarkable performance on complex control problems in systems and networking, including adaptive video streaming, wireless resource management, and congestion control. For safe deployment, however, it is critical to reason about how agents behave across the range of system states they encounter in practice. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：本文分析了深度强化学习代理在系统与网络中的符号属性，以确保安全部署。

简述：本文的核心贡献在于提出了一种新的方法来评估深度强化学习代理在多种系统状态下的行为，超越了传统基于点属性的验证方法。通过引入符号属性分析，研究者能够更全面地理解代理在复杂环境中的表现，从而提高其安全性和可靠性。

papers.title: FileGram: Grounding Agent Personalization in File-System Behavioral Traces
papers.abstract: Coworking AI agents operating within local file systems are rapidly emerging as a paradigm in human-AI interaction; however, effective personalization remains limited by severe data constraints, as strict privacy barriers and the difficulty of jointly collecting multimodal real-world traces prevent scalable training and evaluation, and existing methods remain interaction-centric while overlooking dense behavioral traces in file-system operations; to address this gap, we propose FileGram, a compr
papers.summary_zh:
一句话：FileGram通过文件系统行为追踪实现AI代理个性化，突破数据限制与隐私障碍。

简述：本文提出FileGram方法，旨在利用文件系统的行为追踪数据来实现AI代理的个性化。该方法克服了传统个性化方法在数据收集和隐私方面的限制，能够有效地利用多模态的真实世界数据进行训练和评估，从而提升人机交互的效果。

papers.title: QED-Nano: Teaching a Tiny Model to Prove Hard Theorems
papers.abstract: Proprietary AI systems have recently demonstrated impressive capabilities on complex proof-based problems, with gold-level performance reported at the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO). However, the training pipelines behind these systems remain largely undisclosed, and their reliance on large "internal" models and scaffolds makes them expensive to run, difficult to reproduce, and hard to study or improve upon. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：QED-Nano展示了小型开放模型在证明复杂定理中的能力。

简述：本文提出了一种名为QED-Nano的小型模型，旨在解决大型模型在训练和应用中的高成本和不透明性问题。通过精心设计的训练方法，QED-Nano能够在复杂的数学证明任务中取得显著成果，展示了小型模型在该领域的潜力。

papers.title: Agentic Federated Learning: The Future of Distributed Training Orchestration
papers.abstract: Although Federated Learning (FL) promises privacy and distributed collaboration, its effectiveness in real-world scenarios is often hampered by the stochastic heterogeneity of clients and unpredictable system dynamics. Existing static optimization approaches fail to adapt to these fluctuations, resulting in resource underutilization and systemic bias. In this work, we propose a paradigm shift towards Agentic-FL, a framework where Language Model-based Agents (LMagents) assume autonomous orchestra
papers.summary_zh:
一句话：本文提出Agentic-FL框架，通过语言模型代理实现自主协调的联邦学习。

简述：本文的核心贡献在于引入了基于语言模型的代理（LMagents），使其能够自主管理和协调联邦学习过程，从而应对客户端的异质性和系统动态变化。该方法通过动态优化和资源利用，提高了联邦学习的效率和效果，克服了传统静态优化方法的局限性。

papers.title: Rethinking Exploration in RLVR: From Entropy Regularization to Refinement via Bidirectional Entropy Modulation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, it faces a fundamental limitation termed \textit{restricted exploration}, where the policy rapidly converges to a narrow set of solutions. While entropy regularization is a popular approach used to sustain exploration, it often proves unreliable for LLMs, suffering from high hyperparameter sensitivity and yielding only marginal performance gains. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：本文探讨了在RLVR中通过双向熵调节改进探索策略的有效性。

简述：论文提出了一种新的方法，通过双向熵调节来克服传统熵正则化在强化学习中的局限性，特别是在大语言模型中的应用。该方法有效地增强了探索能力，减少了对超参数的敏感性，从而提高了模型的推理性能。

papers.title: Data Attribution in Adaptive Learning
papers.abstract: Machine learning models increasingly generate their own training data -- online bandits, reinforcement learning, and post-training pipelines for language models are leading examples. In these adaptive settings, a single training observation both updates the learner and shifts the distribution of future data the learner will collect. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：本文提出了一种针对自适应学习的发生级归因方法，解决了动态数据分布下的归因问题。

简述：核心贡献在于将发生级归因形式化，适用于有限时间范围的自适应学习场景。方法上，作者提出了一种新的归因框架，能够有效处理在线学习中数据分布的变化，克服传统静态数据集归因方法的局限性。

papers.title: Synthetic Sandbox for Training Machine Learning Engineering Agents
papers.abstract: As large language model agents advance beyond software engineering (SWE) tasks toward machine learning engineering (MLE), verifying agent behavior becomes orders of magnitude more expensive: while SWE tasks can be verified via fast-executing unit tests, MLE verification requires running full ML pipelines -- data preprocessing, model training, and metric evaluation -- on large datasets at each rollout step, rendering trajectory-wise on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) prohibitively slow. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：提出了一种合成沙箱，用于训练机器学习工程代理，提升验证效率。

简述：该论文的核心贡献在于设计了一种合成沙箱环境，旨在降低机器学习工程代理的验证成本。通过模拟完整的机器学习管道，研究者能够在更短的时间内进行多次实验，从而加速强化学习的训练过程。此方法有效解决了传统验证方法在大规模数据集上的低效问题。

papers.title: Optimizing LLM Prompt Engineering with DSPy Based Declarative Learning
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks; however, their effectiveness is highly dependent on prompt design, structure, and embedded reasoning signals. Conventional prompt engineering methods largely rely on heuristic trial-and-error processes, which limits scalability, reproducibility, and generalization across tasks. papers.summary_zh:
一句话：本文提出DSPy框架优化大语言模型的提示工程，提高其在自然语言处理任务中的效果。

简述：本文的核心贡献在于引入DSPy框架，通过声明式学习优化提示设计，克服传统方法的局限性。研究表明，该方法能够提升提示的可扩展性、可重复性和跨任务的泛化能力，从而增强大语言模型的整体性能。
